dct_creator_sm: Fort Smith Métis Council (FSMC); Government of the Northwest Territories, Environment and Climate Change.
dct_description_sm: This dataset records water quality results gathered by the Fort Smith Métis Council along the Slave River at multiple sites that were of concern to community members. The project began with NWT CIMP funding in the 2023-2024 fiscal year. The data collection is carried out monthly by collecting grab samples, along with the deployment of a PMD and sonde for water quality parameters for the span of the month to continually collect data. This dataset includes dissolved and total metals, major ions, microbiology, nutrients and physical parameters.
dct_title_s: CIMP 232 - Ecotoxicology and Monitoring of Cumulative Effects on the Slave River
